pages.text: The mountain lodge kitchen smelled of bread. Rudi sat right beside the bread oven.
"Is it ready now?" Grandma Bear shook her head.
"Not ready yet." Rudi shuffled their feet.
Outside, the children were laughing. Rudi watched only the oven.
Grandma went out to fetch firewood. Rudi opened the oven door a crack.
Rudi took out a loaf and bit into it. Inside, it was damp and lukewarm.
A little later, Rudi's tummy made a sound. Grrr.
Grandma put a hand on Rudi's tummy. "Your tummy notices first when food isn't cooked through."
Rudi played outside for a long time. On coming back, the smell was richer.
Rudi received the biggest loaf. Crisp outside, fluffy inside.
